messages:
marco: quick thread 1: were seeing deprecation banners trigger unexpected v1 routing. small but noisy. anyone tracked cause?
anya: saw it too. negotiation returns advisory 426 and some SDKs immediately retry the old endpoint. counts show v1 usage bump but it's just retries.
jia: reproduced in staging: advisory -> client retry -> v1 call. attribution logic treats first successful route as billed. feels wrong.
sasha: ops concern: double counting inflates quotas for a short window. finance will be annoyed.
marco: proposal: make negotiation advisory non-billable and introduce a sticky attribution mode separate from pin changes. also add "negotiation_mode" flag (advisory|strict).
anya: telemetry: we can emit routed_count.v1_shadow alongside current billed counter for 7-day reconciliation. alert if shadow - billed > threshold.
jia: dev plan: behind FF: 1) advisory responses don't increment v1 counter, 2) sticky attribution when tenant explicitly pins or calls v1, 3) console shows "advisory events" separately.
sasha: add runbook: if shadow diff spikes, flip negotiation_mode->strict for affected tenants and notify #billing.
telemetry-bot: (auto) linked metrics -> https://internal.metrics/routing/1761112222 :bar_chart:
marco: timeline: small FF tomorrow, shadow counters + alert by EOD. will open PRs and link.
anya: also UX tweak: change banner copy to "advisory" not "deprecated until X" to reduce automatic retry behavior in some SDKs.
marco: thanks all. follow-ups in PR comments.
telemetry-bot: (auto) thread archived to project "deprecation-attribution"
